rows: Total population: all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship, mid-year estimate.
Land area in square kilometres, excluding inland water bodies, national claims to the continental shelf and exclusive economic zones.
Surface area in square kilometres: land area plus inland water bodies.
Gross domestic product in current US dollars, converted at official exchange rates.
Gross domestic product converted to international dollars at purchasing power parity rates, so that a dollar buys the same amount of goods and services in every country.
GDP at purchasing power parity divided by mid-year population, in current international dollars.
Annual growth of GDP at constant prices (after inflation), per cent.
Annual change in consumer prices, per cent. A negative figure is deflation.
Gross national income in current US dollars: GDP plus net income received from abroad.
General government gross debt as a share of GDP, per cent.
Military expenditure in current US dollars, as estimated by SIPRI.
Military expenditure as a share of GDP, per cent, as estimated by SIPRI.
UNDP's Human Development Index (0 to 1): a summary of life expectancy, education and income per person.
Total external debt stocks in current US dollars: debt owed to non-residents, public and private, including IMF credit.
Public and publicly guaranteed external debt in current US dollars: owed by the government or guaranteed by it.
Public external debt owed to multilateral institutions (such as the World Bank and the African Development Bank), current US dollars.
Public external debt owed to other governments and their agencies (bilateral), current US dollars.
Public external debt owed to holders of bonds, current US dollars.
Public external debt owed to commercial banks, current US dollars.
Public external debt owed to other private creditors (such as suppliers), current US dollars.
